features.title: One discount, every line
features.desc: Enter a single Percent or Amount discount and it fans out automatically across every order or invoice line — no manual line-by-line editing.

features.title: Percent or fixed Amount
features.desc: Switch between a percentage rate or a fixed currency amount; Amount mode converts itself into a uniform per-line percentage.

features.title: Manager approval gate
features.desc: Set a company-wide average-discount limit — orders above it move to Waiting Approval instead of confirming.

features.title: Approve or reject in one click
features.desc: A Sales Manager sees dedicated Approve / Reject buttons on any order waiting for review; Reject sends it back to Draft.

features.title: Carries over to invoices
features.desc: Invoice the order and its discount type, rate, and total come along automatically, pre-filled and ready.

features.title: Surcharges, not just discounts
features.desc: A negative rate works as a price increase, fanned out the same way — no floor validation blocking it.

features.title: Shows up on printed documents
features.desc: The discount appears as its own line on printed quotations, invoices, the customer portal, and in analysis reports.

features.title: Informational total, always visible
features.desc: A running Discount total sits next to the order/invoice totals — exact to the amount entered, with no manual line-discount addition needed.

limitations: For Amount-type discounts, individual line discount percentages are rounded to 2 decimals, so a single line's discounted subtotal can be off by a few cents from a perfectly even split — the order/invoice Discount total itself is exact to the amount entered.

The approval-gate average is unweighted and includes 0% and negative lines — a single steep discount can be diluted below the limit by other lines on the same order. This is confirmed intended behavior, not a defect.
